presentation: Fever, diffuse erythematous scaly rash, and eosinophilia 5 weeks after starting allopurinol for gout, in a patient with pre-existing stage III CKD
key_finding: RegiSCAR score 4 (probable DRESS); acute kidney injury superimposed on CKD
outcome: Cutaneous and renal manifestations improved; discharged on a tapering steroid course

presentation: Fever, skin rash and cervical lymphadenopathy starting 8 weeks after allopurinol was begun for asymptomatic hyperuricaemia; drug stopped only 3 days after rash onset
key_finding: Interstitial nephritis with confirmed HHV-6 reactivation
outcome: Fever and rash improved within 5 days, but renal function worsened to severe azotaemia and anuria requiring haemodialysis

presentation: Generalised erythematous pruritic skin lesions about 35 days after starting allopurinol for gout, with marked eosinophilia, acute kidney injury and hepatic dysfunction
treatment: Allopurinol stopped; intravenous hydration, systemic corticosteroids, antihistamines, tapering prednisolone

presentation: Confusion, hypotension, hypoxia and a widespread morbilliform rash about 3 weeks after starting allopurinol for gout, in a patient with a solitary kidney (prior donor nephrectomy) and no intrinsic renal disease
key_finding: Severe acute kidney injury attributed to DRESS despite no intrinsic kidney disease
